sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have not yet received your response to our last proposal. Over the years, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with quality craftsmanship from our region, and we are eager to continue this valued partnership. 

Please let us know your thoughts on the volume commitment we discussed, so we can move forward. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer of €51.60 per unit remains valid. The full terms of our offer are a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We are following up as we have not yet received your response to our last proposal. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Please let us know what volume you can commit to, as this remains the key to any further price adjustments. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Over the years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your esteemed company with reliable castings from our region. We look forward to hearing from you soon so we can bring this to a successful conclusion.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

Over the years, our foundry has always valued the long relationship and strong ties we share within our region. However, after careful consideration, we must inform you that we are withdrawing from this negotiation. We wish Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH all the very best for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
